stem: Based on the table and your knowledge of U.S. history, which statement explains the population trends shown in the table?

options.label: A
options.text: The harsh climate in northern states made it hard for people to live there.

options.label: B
options.text: Southern states primarily consisted of urban hubs because of new transportation networks.

options.label: C
options.text: The warm climate in southern states was good for agriculture and led to urbanization.

options.label: D
options.text: Northern states had economic and social opportunities that attracted immigrants.

visual_elements: This table shows population data from the 1800s.
